note: Etkinlik, örüntü, İngilizce kelime ve Piko poz görselleri için Codex imagegen istekleri (docs/ART.md). Stil metni her isteğe aynen eklenir; Piko pozları ilk Piko oturumundan çatallanır. items.name: piko-jump
items.prompt: Piko (same character as piko-wave), full body. joyful jump straight up with both arms raised high, feet off the ground, two tiny cream motion puffs below it.

items.name: piko-balance
items.prompt: Piko (same character as piko-wave), full body. standing on one leg like a flamingo, the other leg lifted and bent, both arms stretched straight out to the sides, calm focused smile.

items.name: piko-clap
items.prompt: Piko (same character as piko-wave), full body. clapping its rounded arm ends together in front of its chest to a rhythm, joyful open smile, two small curved motion marks beside the arms and one small lavender clay music note floating nearby.

items.name: piko-statue
items.prompt: Piko (same character as piko-wave), full body. frozen mid-move like a statue in a playful freeze game: one arm pointing straight up, one leg lifted, eyes squeezed shut, proud grin, three tiny butter-yellow sparkles around it.

items.name: piko-stretch
items.prompt: Piko (same character as piko-wave), full body. stretching both arms high above its leaves, eyes gently closed, relaxed and calm, a small soft pink clay heart floating beside it.

items.name: piko-talk

items.name: piko-walk

items.name: piko-wait

items.name: tool/street
items.prompt: SCENE, NOT an isolated asset: ignore the magenta background rule for this image. Wide landscape 3:2 image. A cheerful clay diorama of a quiet neighbourhood street, seen from the front and slightly above (camera about 30 degrees down). A straight two-lane asphalt road in soft warm grey runs perfectly horizontally across the whole image from the left edge to the right edge, with a dashed cream centre line. A white zebra crosswalk crosses the road a little right of centre: six thick cream bars that run parallel to the road, stacked from the far sidewalk to the near sidewalk. Pale warm stone sidewalks line the far (upper) and near (lower) edges of the road; soft green grass beyond them; a few round clay bushes and two small round trees on the far side only. The street is completely empty: no vehicles, no people, no animals, no traffic lights, no poles, no signs, no text. The road and both sidewalks together fill the middle 70% of the image height. Soft warm daylight, gentle ambient occlusion.
items.note: Sahne; magenta yok. 1536×1024 çıktının y 120–888 bandı kırpılıp 1200×600 yazıldı.
